exclusions.source_text: Baseline QTc ≤ 480 ms (only for ribociclib patients)
Rapidly progressive brain metastases. Note: only applies to patients with known brain metastases. Brain imaging not required for enrollment.
Current use of drugs that have known potential to prolong the QT interval (e.g., antiarrhythmic drugs), for patients on ribociclib.
Prior or concurrent malignancies that are undergoing active treatment.
